projects.name: Truvit
projects.summary: Helping organizations turn their content libraries into AI models for better operations and personalized training.
projects.description: Truvit helps businesses and education organizations convert their datasets and book/content libraries into AI models that improve operations and deliver personalized training.
projects.collaborators: A technical co-founder who leads engineering, and a cross-border team of 13
projects.idea: An AI-powered reading platform for personalized reading, vocabulary learned in context, and interactive engagement with books.
process: Ran and analyzed 600+ student surveys at Harvard, Boston University, Brandeis, Wellesley and Babson, and turned what learners said into product and content decisions.
Partnered with a Harvard Summer School introduction-to-entrepreneurship course, where students worked on Truvit’s real product and business challenges.
Built a cross-border team of 7 technical and 6 marketing and sales members, and led commercial strategy, partnerships and operations.
outcome: Established a content agreement with Penguin Random House: 100 public-domain books in a first phase, with plans for 6,000 titles in a second.

Expanded from consumer reading technology into customized B2B AI work, including an AI curriculum system for an executive education company that answers questions from its learning materials on demand.

projects.name: Peninsula Montessori Lessons

projects.description: A mobile-friendly site that helps busy preschool teachers search and filter circle-time lesson plans by each child’s interests, so personalized lessons take less prep time.

images.alt: Peninsula Montessori Lessons on a phone: lesson search with age, topic and area filters, and popular activities such as Cleaning Mirror.

projects.name: Lesson Prep Planner

projects.description: A planning tool for Montessori classroom teachers: schedule practical-life activities onto dates, check off materials as they’re ready, and see how much prep time each day needs.

images.alt: Lesson Prep Planner on a phone: a form to schedule an activity, and an overview of prep time.

projects.name: Children’s publishing at Penguin Random House China
projects.label: Publishing
projects.collaborators: Penguin Random House China; author Julia Cook
projects.summary: Children’s books and educational materials, carried between the US and China.
projects.description: Coordinated content strategy, author and editor communication, and publication activities for Penguin Pudge and His 12 Zodiac Friends, a 12-title children’s book series, and helped facilitate publishing arrangements involving author Julia Cook.
process: Worked on cross-border opportunities for Julia Cook’s educational materials, including I Am Money, and assisted her at about three professional conferences.
Reviewed 50+ children’s books and content projects for cross-cultural publishing opportunities in the US and China.

Joined discussions with publishing stakeholders and digital platforms, including Douyin/TikTok China and Alibaba, on copyright and IP protection through the International Publishers Coalition in China.

projects.summary: Small tools for parents, tested during my early-childhood field study.

projects.lessons: Initial interest did not always translate into repeat use or practical value.
